observed_now: 30 AD_SCHEDULE criteria total: 6 per campaign x 5 campaigns. All ENABLED, all negative=false, all bid_modifier=1.0. No bid modifier is lost by removing them.
sunday_finding: None of the five campaigns has a SUNDAY row. Sunday is currently 100% ineligible on every campaign - a full seventh of the week, invisible in a Mon-Sat view.
approach: REMOVE all 30 restrictive AD_SCHEDULE campaign criteria. Do NOT create seven all-day rows per campaign. A campaign with zero ad-schedule criteria already delivers all day, every day, so creating 35 rows would add 35 objects that restate the default, add nothing, and create future maintenance surface.
why_not_create_rows: Creating 7 x 24h rows per campaign (35 objects) is behaviourally identical to having none, but it is 35 more objects to audit, 35 more chances for a partial write, and it re-introduces the exact pattern that produced this problem.
